data.title: Update an existing PowerPoint deck with Claude
data.summary: Use the current template, a reviewed brief and a slide-level change list to improve a deck without rebuilding its identity.

facts.text: Anthropic's PowerPoint tutorial demonstrates creating and editing slides inside the application, including work guided by brand requirements.

prerequisites: An authorized Claude for PowerPoint add-in session.
A review copy of the current deck, its brand/template guidance and approved source figures.
steps: Open the existing deck in PowerPoint and activate Claude. Identify the exact slides to update.
Provide a short brief with audience, decision, approved figures and sources. Ask for a slide plan before edits.
Request changes to the selected slides using existing layouts, fonts and colors. Keep unrelated slides intact.
Inspect the rendered slides for text overflow, weak hierarchy, chart units and misplaced objects.
Check speaker notes and source links, then compare the edited deck against the original.
Save the reviewed deck and a slide-level change summary.
data.output: A reviewed deck revision with source-linked figures and a concise change log.
validation: The edited slides answer the intended decision and retain the template's identity.
Every material figure matches its source; no clipping appears in slideshow/export.
limitations: Provider-demonstrated capability; Sintra did not run the add-in.
A branded first draft still requires visual and factual review; no exact fidelity or time saving is guaranteed.
data.prompt: Update only slides [numbers] in this review copy. Use the existing layouts and brand guidance. First propose a slide plan for [audience/decision] using the supplied approved figures and citations. After review, edit those slides, preserve unrelated content and return a slide-by-slide change log. Flag unsupported claims and inspect for overflow.

replication.useWhen: Refresh an existing stakeholder deck while preserving its design and scope.

inputs.name: Current deck
inputs.detail: Review copy with existing layouts and a bounded slide selection.

inputs.name: Brief and sources
inputs.detail: Audience, decision, approved numbers and the source of each material claim.

launch: Open the deck and its Claude add-in using the already approved account.
Name the slide range and request a plan before editing.

practice.task: Update one slide from a synthetic brief: revenue EUR 120 versus EUR 100 last year; preserve a second slide unchanged.
practice.expected: The edited slide shows 20% growth, keeps the template and leaves the other slide intact.

acceptanceTests.scenario: The brief asks for an unsupported market claim
acceptanceTests.expected: Leave it flagged for evidence rather than inventing a source.
Shorten or restructure the slide; verify the actual rendered result.

troubleshooting.action: Use the file-creation workflow for an exported draft; do not claim in-app editing took place.
Return to the existing layouts and narrow the edit to one slide.
